## Verdict: **FAIL**

Six of seven requested behaviors hold. **Default Agent meaning is still untrue**: the UI describes a New Terminal preselection and a default-agent action that nothing consumes.

## Evidence table

| Criterion | Result | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Settings persistence seam | **PASS** | `AppearanceSettings` uses `useAppearanceSettings` / `saveAppearanceSettings` (`SettingsDialog.tsx` 280–341). Remount test writes theme/accent/density, asserts `loadAppearanceSettings()` + `APPEARANCE_SETTINGS_EVENT`, remounts, and rereads the selects. `settingsRuntime.test.ts` remount/bridge test also passed. |
| Click-to-copy pairing PIN | **PASS** | Enabled PIN is a `button` with `data-testid="remote-pairing-code"`; click calls `navigator.clipboard.writeText(pairingCode)` and shows `Copied` (`SettingsDialog.tsx` 1276–1289). Test clicked enable, found the button, asserted `writeText("482916")` and `/copied/i`. |
| Session-only Remote restart | **PASS** | Native: `persist_config()` writes `mode: off` + `restartPolicy: sessionOnly`; `new_with_paths` forces `mode = Off`, `is_running = false`. Status `enabled` is only `is_running`. UI copy: “The gateway stops when Ferryx quits and must be enabled again after relaunch.” Rust: 2 + 1 + 9 passed. UI copy test passed. |
| Truthful Default Agent meaning | **FAIL** | Copy still says it is the “agent preselected in the New Terminal agent picker and launched by the default agent action.” `defaultAgentId` is only stored in Settings. `NewTabPopover` lists agents with no preselection. `handleLaunchAgent` launches only the clicked agent. No default-agent action/shortcut exists. Producer report itself: “Launcher still does not consume it.” The new test only pins that copy. |
| No Quick Commands UI/storage flow | **PASS** (residual unused key) | Settings nav/section/helpers are gone. Absence test passed. No load/save of `ferryx.settings.quickCommands`. Unused export remains: `QUICK_COMMANDS_STORAGE_KEY` in `ui/src/lib/storageKeys.ts`. Hits under `ui/original-dist/` are leftover original-Orca assets, not current UI. |
| Live workspace props from App | **PASS** | `App.tsx` 848–856 passes `projects`, `activeProjectId`, `activeWorktree`, `onSelectProject`, `onAddProject`, `onAddWorktree`. `WorkspaceSettings` renders registered projects and the active worktree path. App test + `SettingsDialog.workspace.test.tsx` passed. |
| General is non-empty | **PASS** | `GeneralSettings` renders `data-testid="settings-general-overview"` with desktop + section cards; no Appearance controls. Test passed. |
| Focused frontend suite (file-level) | **FAIL (pre-existing, out of scope)** | 2 Ghostty/terminal tests still fail: `getTerminalPreferences` spy never called. Same assertion exists on HEAD; not part of the 7 requested behaviors. |
| `cd ui && npm run build` | **PASS** | `tsc && vite build` succeeded (4.77s). |
| LSP on changed UI sources | **PASS** | `SettingsDialog.tsx` and `App.tsx`: no diagnostics. Test-file LSP timed out (twice). `tsc` in the UI build is the typecheck. |
| Failing-first | **Not independently reproduced** | Implementation is already in tree. Producer logs claim RED then GREEN. Current tests exist and would fail if the new code were removed, except Default Agent, which never tested real consumption. |

## Default Agent (why FAIL)

Settings copy (`SettingsDialog.tsx` 1474):

> Stored preference for the agent preselected in the New Terminal agent picker and launched by the default agent action.

`defaultAgentId` is written only in Settings. `App` loads `agentSettings` for `mergeDetections` / `getLaunchableAgents` (enabled + overrides), never `defaultAgentId`. `NewTabPopover` has no selected/default agent. There is no default-agent action. The new test only asserts that copy, so it cannot catch the lie.

- Unused `QUICK_COMMANDS_STORAGE_KEY` in `ui/src/lib/storageKeys.ts`
- UI `RemoteGatewayStatus` still has no `restartPolicy` field; session-only is hardcoded copy, which matches native
- Two Ghostty Settings tests fail via mock/`getTerminalPreferences` identity; same shape on HEAD
